headline: Titan management maintained growth targets across divisions, with margins fluctuating amid rising gold prices and changing business scales.

promises.promise: New Tanishq stores target is 35 to 40 for the year.
promises.quote: So we look at it in totality, but purely from new stores on Tanishq, I think 35 to 40 is a reasonable range to expect.
promises.evidence: Data is insufficient to settle the full year store count outcome from the provided calls.

promises.promise: Watch margins aimed at 15% to 16% in 1-2 years.
promises.quote: And on a long term, I would say the kind of investments are required, mid - teen is a good number to aim for, 15% to 16% for the business, at least in th e 1-year, 2-year time frame.
promises.evidence: Normalized watch EBIT margin was reported at 17.8% in Q1 FY27, meeting or exceeding mid-teen target.
promises.evidence_quote: So if you normalize for both these sides, then last Quarter 1 FY '26 watch EBIT margin was 18.6% compared to 17.8% normalized margin for this quarter.

promises.promise: Eyewear growth expected to close year around 13% to 14%.
promises.quote: So as far as our growth outlook is concerned, we believe that we should be closing this year at a slightly higher number than what you are seeing, anywhere between 13% to 14%.
promises.evidence: Full year eyewear exact growth is not detailed in later reports.

promises.promise: YTD December growth rates should become better than H1.
promises.quote: But certainly, at a very broad level, I think by the time we end -- we come to YTD December, our growth rates should have become better than the first half growth rates.
promises.evidence: No explicit YTD December growth rate comparison statement is given in subsequent calls.

promises.promise: CaratLane will inch towards a low double-digit EBIT margin.
promises.quote: So I expect that overall margin, we had -- if you remember, a couple of quarters back, we had said that, gradually, CaratLane with the scale will start inching towards double -digit EBIT margin.
promises.evidence: CaratLane margin for the year is almost nearly 10%, achieving low double-digit level.
promises.evidence_quote: But for the year, it's almost nearly 10%.

promises.promise: Continue to deliver volume growth around 8% to 10%.
promises.quote: This is what we have estimated, around an 8% to 10% growth. So this is what we will continue to deliver.
promises.evidence: Omnichannel sale reported a volume growth of close to around 8% in Q3 FY26.
promises.evidence_quote: And this revenue growth has been reported by a volume growth of close to around 8%.

promises.promise: Target 15% to 20% jewellery growth over 3 to 4 years.
promises.quote: Think of it over the next three to four years, what should be the growth. I think India growth story and the formalization of this sector will land you in this space.
promises.evidence: Horizon is 3 to 4 years which has not ended yet.

promises.promise: Center of gravity for jewellery business margin is around 11%.
promises.quote: In the Investor Day and prior, we have said that more of 11% being the center of gravity for jewellery business margin, we would be around that plus/minus something can happen.
promises.evidence: Normalized EBIT margin for Tanishq Mia Zoya business was 10.9% for Q1 FY27.
promises.evidence_quote: So the normalized margin considering both custom duty gain and MTM gain, the normalized EBIT margin for our Tanishq Mia Zoya business would be 10.9%, the number for this quarter.

promises.promise: Targeting a double-digit aggressive growth in jewellery.
promises.quote: If I may add, if you're looking for what is that we are targeting, we are targeting, as always, a double-digit aggressive growth, and that's something which we shared even in the Investor Day.

shifts.change: Shifted from expecting gradual improvement towards low double-digits to reporting an actual near 10% margin.
Refined long-term expectations to a specific 15% to 20% range over 3 to 4 years in Q4 FY26, then reiterated double-digit aggressive growth in Q1 FY27.
